arxiv-1710-06556.title: On the action of the Steenrod algebra on the modular invariants of special linear group
arxiv-1710-06556.creator: Nguyễn Sum
arxiv-1710-06556.description: Abstract . We compute the action of the Steenrod algebra on generators of algebras of invariants of special linear group S ​ L n = S ​ L ​ ( n , ℤ / p ) {SL_{n}=SL(n,\mathbb{Z}/p)} in the polynomial algebra with p p an odd prime number. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 55S10; Secondary 55S05 1.

arxiv-2112-05192.title: Chiriality in a three-band superconducting prism in ZFC and FC processes
arxiv-2112-05192.creator: C. A. Aguirre †, Julián Faúndez and S. G. Magalhães, J. Barba-Ortega
arxiv-2112-05192.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by C. A. Aguirre †, Julián Faúndez and S. G. Magalhães, J. Barba-Ortega. In the present work, we will study the superconducting properties of a mesoscopic three-dimensional prism with square transversal section under an external magnetic field in both Zero-Field Cooling (ZFC) and Field-Cooling (FC) process. The studied sample is a three-band system (with three condensates ψ 1 \psi_{1} , ψ 2 \psi_{2} , ψ 3 \psi_{3} ), in which we take a Josephson type inter-band coupling simulated via γ \gamma parameter.

arxiv-2303-07789.title: Activity Recognition from Newborn Resuscitation Videos
arxiv-2303-07789.creator: Øyvind Meinich-Bache, Simon Lennart Austnes, Kjersti Engan, Ivar Austvoll, Trygve Eftestøl, Helge Myklebust, Simeon Kusulla, Hussein Kidanto, Hege Ersdal
arxiv-2303-07789.description: Abstract Objective: Birth asphyxia is one of the leading causes of neonatal deaths. A key for survival is performing immediate and continuous quality newborn resuscitation. A dataset of recorded signals during newborn resuscitation, including videos, has been collected in Haydom, Tanzania, and the aim is to analyze the treatment and its effect on the newborn outcome.

arxiv-2311-14393.title: On the structure factor of jammed particle configurations on the one-dimensional lattice
arxiv-2311-14393.creator: Jean-Marc Luck
arxiv-2311-14393.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jean-Marc Luck. A broad class of blocked or jammed configurations of particles on the one-dimensional lattice can be characterized in terms of local rules involving only the lengths of clusters of particles (occupied sites) and of holes (empty sites). Examples of physical relevance include the metastable states reached by the zero-temperature dynamics of kinetically constrained spin chains, the attractors of totally irreversible processes such as random sequential adsorption, and arrays of Rydberg atoms in the blockade regime.

arxiv-2401-14810.title: Cyclic Group Projection for Enumerating Quasi-Cyclic Codes Trapping Sets
arxiv-2401-14810.creator: Vasiliy Usatyuk, Yury Kuznetsov, Sergey Egorov
arxiv-2401-14810.description: Abstract This paper introduces a novel approach to enumerate and assess Trapping sets in quasi-cyclic codes, those with circulant sizes that are non-prime numbers. Leveraging the quasi-cyclic properties, the method employs a tabular technique to streamline the importance sampling step for estimating the pseudo-codeword weight of Trapping sets.

arxiv-2409-03641.title: A “Staircase” formula for the Chern-Schwartz-MacPherson cycle of a matroid
arxiv-2409-03641.creator: Franquiz Caraballo Alba, Jeffery Liu
arxiv-2409-03641.description: Abstract We provide a formula for the Poincaré dual of the Chern-Schwartz-MacPherson (CSM) cycle of a matroid in the Chow ring of the matroid. We derive the formula from the ℂ \mathbb{C} -realizable case and prove that it satisfies a contraction-deletion formula. From this fact, we prove it holds for all matroids, confirming a conjecture of Fife and Rincón.

arxiv-2501-17094.title: Resummed effective actions and heat kernels: the Worldline approach and Yukawa assisted pair creation
arxiv-2501-17094.creator: Filippo Fecit, Sebastián A. Franchino-Viñas, and Francisco D. Mazzitelli
arxiv-2501-17094.description: Abstract We adapt the Worldline Formalism to obtain resummed expressions for the effective action and the heat kernel of a quantum scalar field coupled to a Yukawa background. The resummation includes all the invariants built from powers, first derivatives and second derivatives of the latter.

arxiv-2505-24041.title: Relaxation pathways and emergence of domains in square artificial spin ice
arxiv-2505-24041.creator: Matteo Menniti, Naëmi Leo, Pedro Villalba-González, Matteo Pancaldi, Paolo Vavassori
arxiv-2505-24041.description: Abstract Multi-domain states of square artificial spin ice show a range of different morphologies ranging from simple stripe-like domains to more organically shaped coral domains. To model the relevant dynamics leading to the emergence of such diverse domain structures, simplified descriptions of the switching behavior of individual nanomagnets are necessary.

arxiv-2507-10031.title: Positive energy solutions in the anisotropic Kepler problem with homogeneous potential Thanks: This work is supported by the National Key R&D Program of China (2020YFA0713303), NSFC (No. 12171253), Nankai Zhide Foundation and the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities.
arxiv-2507-10031.creator: Guowei Yu
arxiv-2507-10031.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Guowei Yu. We study positive energy solutions of the anisotropic Kepler problem with homogeneous potential. First some asymptotic property of positive energy solutions is obtained, as time goes to infinity. Afterwards, we prove the existence of hyperbolic solutions with given initial configuration and asymptotic behavior, when time goes to positive or negative infinity, and in the planar case, the existence of bi-hyperbolic solutions with given asymptotic behaviors, when time goes to both positive and negative infinities, under various conditions.

arxiv-2509-21086.title: UniTransfer: Video Concept Transfer via Progressive Spatial and Timestep Decomposition
arxiv-2509-21086.creator: Guojun Lei 1 , Rong Zhang 3 , Chi Wang 1 , Tianhang Liu 1 , Hong Li 4 , Zhiyuan Ma 2 , Weiwei Xu 1 1 State Key Lab of CAD&CG, Zhejiang University, 2 Tsinghua University, 3 Zhejiang Gongshang University, 4 Beihang University guojunlei@zju.edu.cn, zhangrong@zjgsu.edu.cn, wangchi1995@zju.edu.cn, mzyth@
arxiv-2509-21086.description: Abstract Recent advancements in video generation models have enabled the creation of diverse and realistic videos, with promising applications in advertising and film production. However, as one of the essential tasks of video generation models, video concept transfer remains significantly challenging.

arxiv-2512-07002.title: On formal deformations and degenerations of evolution algebras
arxiv-2512-07002.creator: Abdenacer Makhlouf 1, Andrés Pérez-Rodríguez 2
arxiv-2512-07002.description: Abstract . The main purpose of this paper is to study formal deformations of evolution algebras, determining their existence and classifying them up to equivalence. In addition, we examine degenerations in this setting and provide Hasse diagrams that describe the degeneration relations among nilpotent evolution algebras of dimensions up to four. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification 13D10, 17D92, 17A60, 17B30 1.

pmc-10566835.creator: Emily Finkelstein, Meaghan Clark, Michael Ha, Kyle Xu, Juan Mella-Catinchi, Yvonne Rasko
pmc-10566835.description: healing approaches. pmc-10573271.title: Cardiac CT in CRT as a Singular Imaging Modality for Diagnosis and Patient-Tailored Management
pmc-10573271.creator: Willem Gerrits, Ibrahim Danad, Birgitta Velthuis, Saima Mushtaq, Maarten J. Cramer, Pim van der Harst, Frebus J. van Slochteren, Mathias Meine, Dominika Suchá, Marco Guglielmo
pmc-10573271.description: Between 30–40% of patients with cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) do not show an improvement in left ventricular (LV) function. It is generally known that patient selection, LV lead implantation location, and device timing optimization are the three main factors that determine CRT response.

pmc-10687718.title: The influence of green human resource management on employees’ green innovation behavior: The role of green organizational commitment and knowledge sharing
pmc-10687718.creator: Min Yang, Zhongbin Li
pmc-10687718.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Employees' green innovation behavior is a key factor in enterprises' promotion of green development strategies. Combining social information processing and social exchange theory, this article considers workers' green organizational commitment (GOC) as a mediating construct and knowledge sharing as a moderating construct and establishes a model of the influence of green human resource management (GHRM) on workers' green innovation conduct in company settings.

pmc-11510615.title: Anti-Alzheimer’s Potency of Rich Phenylethanoid Glycosides Extract from Marrubium vulgare L.: In Vitro and In Silico Studies
pmc-11510615.creator: Mahmoud Emam, Samah A El-Newary, Hanan Y Aati, Bin Wei, Mohamed Seif, Abeer Y Ibrahim, Miguel Valdes, Fernando Calzada, Elena Cichero
pmc-11510615.description: Background/Objectives: Marrubium vulgare L. (M. vulgare), the white horehound, is well known for treating inflammation-related diseases. Methods: In this context, we investigated the efficacy of M. vulgare ingredients in treating Alzheimer’s disease using various in vitro and in silico antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, anti-cholinesterase, and anti-tyrosinase mechanisms.

pmc-11518817.title: Veterinary neurology residency training in Europe—A survey on preparation and plans
pmc-11518817.creator: Rita Gonçalves
pmc-11518817.description: IntroductionDifficulties in recruitment of veterinary specialists to academia is an ongoing problem for university teaching hospitals. The aim of this study was to determine the proportion of veterinary neurology specialists that plan to work in academia after their residency training and identify the main factors that may influence that decision.

pmc-11564278.title: Bone conducted cervical vestibular evoked myogenic potentials: comparison of tone burst stimulus vs chirp stimulus
pmc-11564278.creator: Ceren Karaçaylı, Ercan Karababa, Bülent Satar
pmc-11564278.description: PurposeVestibular evoked myogenic potential (VEMP) is a test used to evaluate the function of otolith organs. In healthy individuals, air-conducted (AC) responses are obtained, whereas, in conductive hearing loss, the inability to transmit the signal well enough with AC stimuli has led to the need for bone-conducted (BC) stimuli.

pmc-11709400.title: The Dark Side of STING Signaling In Niemann‐Pick Disease Type C And Other Neurodegenerative Diseases
pmc-11709400.creator: Ting‐Ting Chu
pmc-11709400.description: BackgroundThe classic mode of STING activation is through binding the cyclic dinucleotide 2′3′‐cyclic GMP–AMP (cGAMP), produced by the DNA sensor cyclic GMP–AMP synthase (cGAS), which is important for the innate immune response to microbial infection and autoimmune disease. Modes of STING activation that are independent of cGAS are much less well understood.

pmc-13445779.description: A 69‐year‐old male patient developed a painless, gradually increasing mass in the upper part of his right thigh, with no pulmonary symptoms. Magnetic resonance imaging revealed a nodular lesion in the lateral femoral muscle, which was initially suspected to be a primary soft tissue tumour.

pmc-13672160.title: Renal Abscess Secondary to Urinary Tract Obstruction Caused by Pelvic Organ Prolapse: A Report of Two Cases
pmc-13672160.creator: Hiroki Sai, Kumiko Kato, Atsushi Kiyota, Yukiko Tsunoda, Masashi Kato
pmc-13672160.description: IntroductionPelvic organ prolapse can cause urinary tract obstruction, leading to hydronephrosis, pyelonephritis, and in rare cases, renal abscess.Case PresentationWe report two elderly women with advanced pelvic organ prolapse who developed renal abscesses. Both presented with pyelonephritis and acute renal impairment accompanied by bilateral hydronephrosis. Imaging demonstrated poorly enhanced renal lesions consistent with renal abscess.
